_note: Paper C Stage 1 grid. One cell = (arm, variant_tag, base_model, subset, seed). The arm decides the segment and which baseline the cell pairs against; the segment decides which run_id pattern applies. Edit arms/variant_tags here and regenerate - never hand-edit run_queue.csv.

arms.purpose: reproduce the 30 frozen fixed40 cells on lab3090; the delta is a reconciliation signal, not a module effect
the module cells; each pairs against its own segment-A cell from this same batch, never against the cross-machine ledger

variant_tag_meaning.k0p: CADF v1.2, proportional K0=ceil(0.2*window) - the main arm (L=30->6, 45->9, 50->10)
variant_tag_meaning.k0a: CADF v1.2, absolute K0=15 cycles (B_min only, already run as v1.2; NOT part of this 60-cell batch)
variant_tag_meaning.eng: CADF v1.2, engineering mode only (no window baseline)

gate_trace.meaning: gate_open_epoch = first epoch with mean(gate) > threshold, or 'none' if the gate never opened

delta_sign: delta_val_rmse = baseline_val_engine_mean_rmse - val_engine_mean_rmse; positive means the cell is better (lower RMSE). Segment A: baseline = frozen ledger (reconciliation). Segment B: baseline = this batch's segment-A cell (module effect).
